description: races: Result by bib. GET /v1/races/results. One runner's official result, by bib number, in one schema for all three platforms: names, chip and gun time, pace, overall, gender and age-group place, and splits where the platform publishes them. runsignup needs race_id and event_id. athlinks needs event_id and may take course_id (without it the event's courses are tried, largest first). raceroster needs event_id and may take course_id when a bib is used in more t Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.

course_id.description: athlinks and raceroster: the course or race within the event, from /v1/races/events.

event_id.description: The event or edition id from /v1/races/search or /v1/races/events.

platform.description: Timing platform: runsignup, athlinks (also carries ChronoTrack events) or raceroster.

race_id.description: runsignup only: the RunSignup race id.

name: races_results
